'''Calli Trilm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Clysm Fleet]] and [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Trilm was known to be a confidante of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], and according to the records of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Laurita Tohm]], she may have been even closer with him. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she was captured by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and was imprisoned within [[The Prism]].

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the subsequent [[Ghost Prison incident|Gentis coup]], Trilm was released and became part of a [[Mission to the Prism|brutal test]] created by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, to see who among the prisoners was worthy of joining the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Trilm was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the battle.
